articles.title: Uterus transplants help women achieve successful pregnancies, analysis shows
articles.excerpt: A decade of uterus transplantation in the United States has resulted in dozens of healthy births and steadily improving surgical outcomes, according to a new national review led by researchers from the Perelman School of Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania.
articles.summary: 美国一项全国性综述显示，子宫移植开展十年来已实现数十例健康活产，手术结局持续改善。
